## Welcome to **Git Quest · Season 2**, agent @{login}!

Same rules as season 1: I post a mission, you do it, you comment **`/check`**, I answer in about 30 seconds with your flag `SecurinetsENIT{...}` (personal, computed from your username) and the next mission.

This season you'll clean a repository, prove who you are with an SSH signature, juggle unfinished work, rewrite history, pick a single commit out of a branch, and ship a release.
